Verify /readyz and /version return 200 and exactly match the packaged version, commit, build timestamp, Go version, and linux/amd64 architecture.
Verify the serving migration policy accepts the validated ledger and no startup loop, database write failure, license failure, or migration-status warning appears.
If readiness or version is wrong, stop and use the approved package-plus-database rollback path.
acceptance: Compose reports the intended router healthy.
Public readiness and version identify the exact deployed artifact.
The router remains stable through the agreed observation interval.
task.status_reason: Pending because the package installation and non-serving migration in task.deploy_and_migrate have not completed.
next_steps: Start the production containers and verify Compose state, /readyz, /version, migration state, and logs.

task.title: Run production API, telemetry, report, and real CLI acceptance
actions: Run bounded authenticated OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages text smokes against a deployment-defined permitted group; retain only safe request IDs, status, latency bucket, selected target metadata, usage presence, and sanitized error class.
Run tool-call and streaming-usage smokes appropriate to current production routes; assert tool-call shape, real created-file contents, and required usage chunks.

Run actual Codex CLI text/tool smoke through Responses and actual Claude Code text/tool smoke through Anthropic Messages using the documented router auth precedence; assert output/result metadata and file contents.
Verify /metrics succeeds only for metrics_admin and returns 403 metrics-forbidden to an ordinary caller; verify aggregate migration metrics are present without tenant/token labels.
Verify the read-only admin migration report and representative usage reports on production PostgreSQL, including latency/performance views, without exposing raw rows.

For any reproducible non-2xx, schema mismatch, translation loss, malformed tool call, missing usage, or dialect discrepancy, stop rollout and follow AGENTS.md incident-fixture/issue policy; aggregate same-cycle findings under policy.bounded_review_followup.
acceptance: All three API skins, required tool/stream surfaces, both real CLIs, metrics isolation, migration visibility, and usage reporting pass.
No raw prompts, tool schemas, images, outputs, tokens, hashes, keys, credentials, config, DSNs, or raw database rows are retained.
task.evidence: Sanitized endpoint/dialect, model group, HTTP status, request ID, latency bucket, tool/usage assertions, selected target metadata, report name, and aggregate outcome.
task.status_reason: Pending until task.start_and_health proves the new production containers are healthy.
next_steps: Run production API, telemetry, report, Codex CLI, and Claude Code CLI acceptance checks.
human_actions: Provide caller/client acceptance after the production smoke evidence is available.

task.title: Verify embedded production documentation
actions: Verify /docs/ and the required migration, upgrade, deployment, API compatibility, errors, model access, usage reporting, VLM/tool, release index, release note, and upgrade-guide pages return 200.
Confirm every sampled page banner and docs-version metadata match /version and the deployed build timestamp.
Confirm public pages contain no source-control workflow language, private host/path/SSH details, secrets, production configuration, or stale pre-migration guidance.
Exercise public examples that changed in this release using placeholder credentials or approved ignored runtime credentials as required by AGENTS.md.
acceptance: Hosted docs are reachable, version-aligned, current, customer-safe, and consistent with the shipped migration and rollback behavior.
task.status_reason: Pending until task.start_and_health makes the embedded documentation from the new package available.

task.title: Clean production and local deployment artifacts
actions: After production is healthy, remove uploaded package/config staging files, superseded temporary unpack directories, and stale Docker images/build cache/containers; retain only intentional timestamped backups required by rollback policy.

Remove generated local release artifacts only when no longer needed for evidence or rollback; never add dist, logs, DBs, env.json, config.production.yaml, tokens, license material, or state files to Git.

Remove clean confirmed-merged or explicitly abandoned worktrees/branches identified by task.reconcile_tracking; do not delete PR#766 or issue-702 artifacts until their unique-work checks and human decisions are complete.
Prune worktree metadata and verify the remaining worktree inventory, branch purposes, repository status, open PRs, and open scoped issues.
acceptance: Production has no unnecessary uploaded package or temporary deployment residue.
Every remaining backup is intentional and documented.
Every remaining local worktree/branch maps to active authorized work.
The repository is clean except for explicitly retained ignored operational files and this tracked plan.

task.title: Consolidate pre-release tracking, candidate, and local validation hygiene
task.description: Single active lifecycle task that preserves release safety: reconcile issue/worktree state, establish a clean reviewable candidate, and complete the local release validation before packaging.
actions: Confirm #732 acceptance is fully represented by merged PR#733 and its evidence; close #732 with a concise link if authorized, otherwise record the exact remaining criterion without creating another issue.

For the issue-702 worktree, note that #702 is closed while PR#711 is closed unmerged and its branch is not proven merged. Compare its commits/patch to origin/main and issue closure evidence; remove it only if clean and fully represented or explicitly abandoned by the human.
After the #765/#767 replacement is merged or explicitly abandoned, remove the clean issue-765 worktree and obsolete local branch only when no unique work remains.
Prune only stale worktree metadata created by confirmed removals.
Fetch origin and fast-forward the clean local main; do not package the stale snapshot recorded above.
Confirm #765 and #767 are closed by merged evidence or explicitly waived, PR#766 is resolved, required checks on all merged heads passed, and no P0/P1 release blocker remains.
Run rtk make release-notes-from-git, review generated language for customer safety and migration/rollback accuracy, update required version metadata and upgrade guidance, then run docs QA/build.

If release-note or generated-doc changes exist, commit them on a focused branch, open one PR, observe it for ten minutes under policy.bounded_review_followup, and obtain exact-head merge authorization.
Refresh main again and require a clean tree and a stable non-dirty git-described version.
Run focused migration and SQLite auto-safe regressions before the broad suites.
Run the changed-path router-migrate plan/apply/resume/verify/status smoke against local disposable SQLite and PostgreSQL as required by docs/DATA_MIGRATIONS.md.
Run applicable production-derived fixtures under testdata/smokes/production-derived without production secrets.
Investigate every failure; do not label a failing suite irrelevant without recording a reproducible reason and passing the narrower release-critical suite.
acceptance: Every retained worktree has an open purpose.
No unique unmerged work is deleted.
GitHub issue states match verified delivery state.
Release notes describe the migration contract, operator impact, caller impact, validation, and restore-required rollback without private deployment facts.
Main is clean, current with origin/main, and contains every authorized fix and generated artifact.
No unresolved P0/P1 finding or unreviewed source change is in the candidate.
Focused regressions, release-critical Go suites, vet, docs QA/build, admin browser E2E, package validator self-test, diff check, and migration smoke pass on the same clean candidate SHA.
evidence: Sanitized command, exit status, named contract, environment class, and safe scalar results only.
